entities.name: Community Summaries → Community Answers→ Global Answer
entities.description: A multi-stage process for generating a final answer from community summaries using a hierarchical structure.
entities.normalized_name: community summaries community answers global answer

entities.name: Prepare community summaries
entities.description: A step where community summaries are shuffled and divided into chunks of pre-specified token size.

entities.name: Map community answers
entities.description: A step where intermediate answers are generated in parallel and scored for helpfulness.

entities.name: Reduce to global answer
entities.description: A step where intermediate answers are sorted by score and iteratively added to a context window to generate the final answer.
